**Why this file exists (E-7).** The 378 witness logs under `build/erp/*.log` are gitignored, so the
ledger's PASSes were re-verifiable only from local disk — one `git clean -x` from being prose. This
digest is the retention mechanism: not the logs, but a small tracked record of **what each log said
and what it hashed to**. After a clean, the record survives; re-running the bundle must reproduce the
same verdicts, and any log whose content moved shows up in one `git diff`.

The verdict column uses the **same marker regexes** `build/erp/run_witness.sh` gates on, so this file
can never disagree with the gate. A witness with no log on disk is recorded as such — never as a pass,
never omitted.
